tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅༅/ /na mo gu ru badz+ra ku mā ra ya/ snyan brgyud phur pa'i gnad tig gi bsnyen sgrub nyams su len pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba yo byad kyi gshom ni/ dam tshig gi bris sku sogs rten bkrams pa'i mdun gyi stegs bu'am gtor gdan du 'dzom na ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bkram/ ma 'dzom na maṇ+ḍal steng me tog sngon po'i tshom bu gtso bo gcig /'khor bcu dang*/ de rgyab sgo bzhi'i tshul du bzhi bkod pa'i khar 'phrul stegs steng e khrom la bsnyen phur yungs dkar gyi thum btags pa la byugs bdug brab gsum gyis gzi byin bskyed pa bkod/ mdun du mchod gtor dpal bshos mtheb kyus bcus bskor ba'i g.yas su smin lugs dam can spyi gtor/ g.yon du phur srung bcu drug gi gtor spungs/ gsum ka dar gdugs mthing ga bcas/ de'i g.yas g.yon du sman rag chu gnyis nyer spyod phreng tshar ram bskor bsham/ rgyab ngos su tshe 'brang bum gzugs/ g.yas g.yon du mngar gsum dang sbyar ba'i tshe ril chang*/ tshe 'da' dar sna me long g.yu byang nṛ yig btags pa rnams bzhag /gzhan yang sngon 'gro dkar bgegs/ gter srung gtor 'bul/ tshogs byed na de'i chas dang*/ chad brtan/ nyer mkho rnams tshogs par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gsum las/ dang po ni/ sngon 'gro sna sel sāts+tsha chu gtor/ gsung rabs klog pa/ bshags sbyong sogs spyi 'gre ltar ci 'grub bya/ phyi dro zhig nas thun gyi dbu brtsams te rnam 'joms kyis bsgrubs pa'i khrus chab kyis gnas khang yo byad thams cad la 'thor/ dkar gtor spyi 'gro btang*/ sgo drung du tho dkar po btsug pa la rgyal chen bskyed bstims sam gtor 'bul yang spyi ltar bya tshig bdun dang spros bral bde chen lta bu'i brgyud 'debs btang*/

brgyud 'debs dang las byang rjes su chog bsgrig byas pa yod pas yig cha gzhan du btsal mi dgos mchan/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yang dag zab tig kha bsgyur can tshar gsum/ bgegs gtor byin brlabs bsngo ba rnams smin lugs ltar spyi 'gro byas/ gu gul bdug /yungs thun dang sum bha ni'i drag sngags kyis bgegs bskrad/ gter gzhung srung ba'i skabs ltar srung 'khor bsgoms la srung sngags lan mang du brjod/ nyin dang po phur pa byin brlab ni/ bsdus pa gter gzhung dbu nas 'byung ba des kyang 'thus mod/ sa phur ltar grub na legs pas sngags so sor brjod la byug bdug brab gsum dang*/ byin rlabs rnams de ltar byas la/ e khram du brtan par gzug /gter gzhung*/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag: sogs dang sngags mang du brjod/ de nas mchod pa byin rlabs/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: rnam dag chos dbyings ngang nyid las: rang byung mchod pa'i sprin phung 'di: kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin lta bus: dpag yas nam mkha' gang bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas/ shap+da pū dza sa ma ye hūm̐: sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta ba liṃ ta āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod/ de nas mngon rtogs ting nge 'dzin rnam gsum nas bdag mdun dbyer med du byas la dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bskyed/ ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstim/ phyag mchod bstod pa'i bar du btang*/ de nas dzab dmigs bsnyen pa ma rdzogs bar du sngags phreng yab yum zhal du 'khor ba do li'am mgal me bskor ba lta bu kho nar dmigs pa gtad la kī la 'bru dgu pa bzla dgos pas/ thog mar phreng ba byin rlabs spyi 'gre'am/ dbyangs gsal dang*/ oṃ ru tsi ra ma ṇa pra brta na ye swā hā/ zhes lan bdun brjod pas byin brlabs nas bzlas pa la 'jug /thun mthar sgrub sngags phreng skor tsam bzla/ dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying rnams lan gsum gsum brjod pas lhag chad kha bskang zhing brtan par bya/

ye shes lha tshogs sogs kyis stong tshig phul/ dgong thun 'di'i mjug tu bka' srung spyi bye brag gi gtor 'bul re grub dgos pas/ spyir smin lugs dam can spyi gtor nyid legs shing*/ bstod pa'i 'phros su bye brag phur srung gtor chog re dgos pas/ skabs 'dir phur srung gtor 'bul sa phur ltar mdzad na legs shing*/ nyung dgos skabs smin lugs rjes 'brang nang gsal des kyang chog /skabs 'dir dgong re bzhin grub na legs shing*/ ma grub na nyin dang po dang*/ nya stong brgyad gsum/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum so sor grub pa'i skabs thams cad kyi rjes rnams la tshogs mchod re phul dgos pas 'don cha yang dag zab tig nas len dgos/ tshogs kyi thog mar brjod med don bshags ye shes sku mchog tshar re gsungs pa phyag len yin cing*/ de 'phros sman gtor rak+ta mar me'i skong ba bcas pa'ang tshar re ma chags na legs/ de nas tshogs byin rlabs nas lhag ma'i bar du gtong*/ lhag ma sgrub pa ma grol bar snod gcig tu khebs kyis bkab/ de nas tshogs mgron la gtang rag mchod bstod las byang ltar dang*/ ma rnyed yongs su sogs dang yig brgya brjod la nongs bshags bya/ 'dir ni rten dang sogs kyis brtan bzhugs bya/ bdag bskyed 'od gsal du bsdu zhing thun mtshams kyi lhar ldangs pa dang*/ bsngo smon shis brjod rnams zab tig ltar bya/ zab tig las blang dgos rigs tshogs ma gtogs gzhan kun mkhyen bla ma nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rgyun khyer la cha tshang yod pas de ltar gnang bas 'thus/ 'di man chad thun gzhan rnam la dkar bgegs bsngo ba dang bgegs bskrad rnams mi dgos pas/ srod thun la tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ le'u bdun ma nas/ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i dgongs pa yis/ sogs tshig rkang lnga/ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i gzhal yas sogs tshig rkang lnga gsung srol snang*/ de nas skyabs sems/ srung 'khor gsal 'debs/

mchod pa byin brlabs/ mngon rtogs nas bstod pa'i bar dang*/ phreng ba byin brlabs bcas bsnyen thun bzung*/ thun 'jug sgrub sngags kha skong stong tshigs sogs nas/ 'od gsal bsdu ldangs/ bsngo smaun shis brjod bcas nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la 'jug /thun re re bzhin mchod pa kha gsos la bdud rtsis bran pa'ang ma chags par bya/ phyir nang thor thun la ldangs ba'i rnal 'byor gyis ldangs/ ngag byin brlabs/ bdud rtsi ril bu'am chos sman myang*/ tshig bdun nas brtsam/ mjug gi shis brjod bar srod thun dang 'dra/ de lta bu'i snga dro/ phyi dro/ srod thun te thun bzhi'am/ thor thun mi lcogs na/ snga/ phyi/ srod thun gsum gcod lugs de kho na ltar la/ phyi thun nam dgongs thun gsham du gtor 'bul ma chags pa dang*/ tshogs mchod nam grub kyang skabs der phul lugs nyin dang por smos pa ltar ro/ /de lta bus bsnyen pa rab 'bum phrag bcu/ ma grub na bdun rdzogs pa dang*/ /gnyis pa sgrub pa ni mchod gtor kha gso/ dkar bsngo ba bgegs bskrad bskyar grub na legs/ srung 'khor gsal 'debs/ 'don 'grigs sngar ltar la bzlas pa'i thog mar sgrub sngags la/ phaṭa dzaḥbatags pas mdun dkyil gyi go sar dzab khang dbye/ thog mar 'bru dgu stong phrag tsam bzla/ de nas do li la spro bsdu'i dmigs gnad sbyar te sgrub sngags bcu bzhi pa bzlas pa'i dngos gzhi bya/ thun mjug gi bya ba sngar dang 'dra ba las dzab khang rang la bsdu ba tsam khyad par ro/ /de lta bu'i sgrub sngags 'bum tsho bcu bzhi ni tshad yin la/ bye ba bzlas kyang chog pa gter gzhung las gsungs so/ /de ltar sgrub pa thems nas gsum pa las sbyor ni/ 'don 'grigs dang dmigs gnad kyi gzhi sgrub pa'i skabs dang 'dra ba las bsnyen sgrub sngags stong rtsa re tsam dang*/ sgrub sngags la spu gri btags pa bzla/ thun rjes sogs 'dra/ dmigs pa rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer mdun bskyed la phog

/de las 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub pa 'phros/ khro bcu phra thabs sgo ma dam can rnams la phog pas de rnams las sprul pa'i pho nya dpag tu med pa 'phros/ byang chub sgrub pa la bar du gcod cing bstan 'gro la 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs thams cad mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las drug gis ming tsam yang med par rdul du brlag par bsam/ sngags grangs khri phrag tu gsungs kyang gong du sgrub sngags mang du ma song na stong phrag las mang mi bya'o/ /gsum pa rjes ni bkra shis pa'i ched du mtha' rgyas tshe'i sgrub pa sbyor te/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum grub pa'i thor thun nam snga dro nas dbu btsugs/ 'don 'grigs snga ma ltar la/ bsnyen sgrub bzlas pa khyugs tsam song rjes gter gzhung gsham gyi/ bdag mdun badz+ra ku mā ra'i/ sogs kyi bzlas dmigs dang*/ sgrub sngags gsham du tshe sham sbyar ba bzla/ thun mthar mda' dar dmar po g.yabs la tshe 'gugs bya/ thun rjes snga ma rnams dang mtshungs/ 'di la spyir ji tsam mang na legs kyang*/ grangs gtsor byed na 'bum phrag las mi nyung ba dang*/ zhag gtsor byed na bdun las mi nyung ba bya'o/ /de ltar bsnyen sgrub mtha' rgyas bcas grub pa'i thor thun lta bur mchod pa rgyas pa dang gtor 'bul tshogs mchod sogs bzang du bshams/ phrin las bzlas pa tshe sgrub kha skong stong tshigs bcas song nas srung ma'i gtor chog /bshags skong*/ tshogs mchod phul/ lhag ma sngar bsags pa rnams dang bcas phyi rol du btang*/ chad mdo dang mnyam du bka' srung gtor ma'ang phyi rol du 'bul zhing bstan ma bskyang*/ mchod bstod phul/ sgrub sngags la/ kā ya sid+dhi oṃ/ wā ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ sarba sid+dhi hrī: btags pa brgya rtsa sogs ci 'grub bzla/ mdun bskyed kyi gnas gsum nas sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thams cad 'od zer dang 'bru gsum dkar dmar mthing gsum char babs pa ltar 'phros nas rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub ma lus pa thob par bsams la zab tig ltar dngos grub bskul tshig brjod la/

sgrub rten phur bu/ tshe 'brang rnams gnas gsum du gtugs/ tshe ril chang rol/ de nas nongs bshags/ brtan bzhugs phyir sngar ltar dang*/ bla ma yi dam lta bu'i bsngo smon/ zhal nas gsungs pas thog drangs shis brjod rgyas par bya/ grub na kha skong du zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bsnyen sgrub kyi bcu cha dgos pa smin lugs las thams cad pa lta bus chog cing 'di'i sbyin sreg chos blo'i chog bsgrig yod mchan/ 'brel 'jog bsnyen sgrub zla gcig ma lta bu la/ bsnyen pa bdun phrag gnyis/ sgrub pa bdun phrag gnyis/ las sbyor nyin gcig tshe sgrub zhag gsum tsam bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang lung zin sprul pa'i chos rgyal rin po che dpal ldan 'chi med rtag pa'i rdo rjes nyams bzhes gsal 'debs su ku sā li blo gros mtha' yas kyis phul ba dge legs 'phel/ /sarba dā maṅga laṃ// //
